prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: NPC076 happy horizontal-thinking eye atlas. Use only the single supplied local reference grid. It shows the selected happy open-eye pair on the top row and selected half-lid pair on the bottom row.

Generate one exact 2×2 atlas with four equal, complete native 64×35 upper-face crops, full canvas ratio 64:35. No labels, dividers, gutters, borders, padding, extra rows, zooms, or extra panels. Exact row-major order: LEFT OPEN / RIGHT OPEN / LEFT HALF / RIGHT HALF.

Preserve the selected NPC076 happy brows, lower-lid smile creases, eye spacing, narrow aperture, hair, framing and low-contrast warm-brown pixel palette. Preserve compact dark olive-brown/amber iris and pupil geometry, source hue and tiny muted warm glints. Only move gaze horizontally. Shift both colored iris/dark pupil clusters together about one native pixel toward canvas-left in both LEFT cells and about one pixel toward canvas-right in both RIGHT cells. Keep both eyes aligned and convergent. Neither eye may stay centered while the other shifts. Do not change iris size, shape or relative pupil position.

Keep the sclera dark and subdued in the source shadow, with no cream-white horizontal bands, broad pale sclera, bright white flash, enlarged eyeball opening, round/vector iris, or added eye white. Lower row must retain the selected source HALF aperture: upper lids cover most of both irises; show only the source-like narrow slit. Do not reopen eyes or shrink irises. Keep all other source pixels and pixel-cluster style stable. No blur, gradients, text, watermark, or additional objects.
